name: settings-billing
title: Settings and billing
author: Eduardo Retana
description: General, members, billing, and API tabs, with segmented credit usage, plans, a payment method, monthly or yearly prices, and invoices.

files.content:
"use client" /** * Settings with a billing surface: segmented credits, plan, payment method, * a monthly/yearly price switch, and invoices. No payment data leaves the page. */ import * as React from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input" import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs" import { ScreenFrame, type AppShellProps, type ShellDensity } from "@/components/ui/app-shell" export type BillingInterval = "monthly" | "yearly" export type CreditUsage = { used: number reserved: number total: number unit?: string } export type BillingPlan = { id: string name: string description: string monthly: number yearly: number current?: boolean features: string[] } export type PaymentMethod = { brand: string last4: string expires: string holder: string } export type InvoiceStatus = "paid" | "open" | "void" export type InvoiceRow = { id: string number: string date: string amount: string status: InvoiceStatus } export type MemberRow = { id: string name: string email: string role: string } export type SettingsBillingClassNames = { root?: string usage?: string plans?: string payment?: string invoices?: string } export type SettingsBillingProps = { usage?: CreditUsage plans?: BillingPlan[] interval?: BillingInterval defaultInterval?: BillingInterval onIntervalChange?: (interval: BillingInterval) => void payment?: PaymentMethod invoices?: InvoiceRow[] members?: MemberRow[] workspaceName?: string currency?: string locale?: string onChangePlan?: (planId: string) => void onDownloadInvoice?: (invoiceId: string) => void shell?: boolean shellProps?: Partial density?: ShellDensity className?: string classNames?: SettingsBillingClassNames defaultTab?: "general" | "members" | "billing" | "api" } export const billingUsage: CreditUsage = { used: 640, reserved: 80, total: 1280, unit: "créditos" } export const billingPlans: BillingPlan[] = [ { id: "start", name: "Inicio", description: "Un espacio y tres proyectos.", monthly: 0, yearly: 0, features: ["3 proyectos", "Correo de soporte"], }, { id: "team", name: "Equipo", description: "El plan actual de Acme.", monthly: 24, yearly: 240, current: true, features: ["Proyectos sin tope", "Créditos compartidos", "Facturas"], }, { id: "studio", name: "Estudio", description: "Más créditos y un administrador.", monthly: 64, yearly: 640, features: ["Todo lo de Equipo", "Administrador dedicado", "Retención de un año"], }, ] export const billingPayment: PaymentMethod = { brand: "Tarjeta", last4: "4242", expires: "08 / 28", holder: "Acme Studio", } export const billingInvoices: InvoiceRow[] = [ { id: "in-184", number: "A-184", date: "01 oct 2026", amount: "$24.00", status: "paid" }, { id: "in-173", number: "A-173", date: "01 sep 2026", amount: "$24.00", status: "paid" }, { id: "in-162", number: "A-162", date: "01 ago 2026", amount: "$24.00", status: "open" }, ] export const billingMembers: MemberRow[] = [ { id: "mara", name: "Mara Solís", email: "mara@acme.example", role: "Administradora" }, { id: "ines", name: "Inés Quesada", email: "ines@acme.example", role: "Edición" }, { id: "omar", name: "Omar Beltrán", email: "omar@acme.example", role: "Lectura" }, ] const invoiceLabel: Record = { paid: "Pagada", open: "Abierta", void: "Anulada", } function money(value: number, locale: string, currency: string) { return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: "currency", currency, maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(value) } export function SettingsBilling({ usage = billingUsage, plans = billingPlans, interval, defaultInterval = "monthly", onIntervalChange, payment = billingPayment, invoices = billingInvoices, members = billingMembers, workspaceName = "Acme", currency = "USD", locale = "es-MX", onChangePlan, onDownloadInvoice, shell = true, shellProps, density = "comfortable", className, classNames, defaultTab = "billing", }: SettingsBillingProps) { const space = density === "compact" ? "p-3" : "p-5" const [intervalState, setIntervalState] = React.useState(defaultInterval) const period = interval ?? intervalState const [notice, setNotice] = React.useState("") const [alias, setAlias] = React.useState(payment.holder) const [editingPay, setEditingPay] = React.useState(false) const [invite, setInvite] = React.useState("") const [keyVisible, setKeyVisible] = React.useState(false) const safeTotal = Math.max(usage.total, 0) const used = Math.min(Math.max(usage.used, 0), safeTotal) const reserved = Math.min(Math.max(usage.reserved, 0), Math.max(safeTotal - used, 0)) const free = Math.max(safeTotal - used - reserved, 0) const unit = usage.unit ?? "créditos" const segments = [ { id: "used", label: "Usados", value: used, className: "bg-primary" }, { id: "reserved", label: "Apartados", value: reserved, className: "bg-chart-2" }, { id: "free", label: "Disponibles", value: free, className: "bg-muted" }, ] function setPeriod(next: BillingInterval) { onIntervalChange?.(next) if (interval === undefined) setIntervalState(next) } return (

api.name: usage
api.description: Used, reserved, and total credits. The meter is segmented.

api.name: plans / interval
api.description: Monthly and yearly prices. The switch is a pressed button group.

api.name: payment
api.description: Brand, last four, expiry, and an alias. The piece does not collect a card number.

api.name: invoices
api.description: Number, date, amount, and status, with a download button for the host.

api.name: members
api.description: People on the members tab, plus an invite field.

docs: Inspirado en patrones de Affect UI (preview público); reimplementación clean-room; no código ni assets de Affect. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo que el anfitrión ya tiene, responde no. La pieza no trae tema, cssVars ni colores fijos. No envía datos de pago. Instalar también trae @retana/app-shell.
